arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS mastercard_credit_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.card_brand = 'Mastercard' AND c.card_type = 'Credit'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions made with Mastercard credit cards, narrowing the earlier Mastercard count to credit cards only.
assumptions: 'Credit' means card_type = 'Credit' exactly; no other card types are included.
Counts all transactions regardless of whether they carry a fraud label, matching the earlier count.
